summary: The CSS variables each component offers for customisation. A public variable has a single dash after the block (--sf-badge-color); the Framework never sets one, and reads it wherever a resting look is defined -- the base rule, sizes, appearances, schemes, statuses -- but not where a state is drawn (hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, an error), so states still show over a customised look. Set one on the component or on any ancestor. Every other --sf-<block>--* variable is internal: it may be renamed or removed in any release. A public variable is renamed or removed only through the change journal, as an attribute is.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-color
variables.summary: The explanation's text; the body keeps the variant role under it.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-border-color
variables.summary: The explanation's border.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-radius
variables.summary: The explanation's corner radius.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-max-width
variables.summary: The explanation's widest line, never wider than the viewport.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-padding-inline
variables.summary: Space at the start and end of the explanation.

variables.summary: Space above and below the explanation.

variables.name: --sf-help-mark-gap
variables.summary: Space between the heading and the text.

variables.name: --sf-progress-bar-fill-color
variables.summary: The filled part; a status gives its own colour unless this is set.

variables.summary: The track under the filled part.

variables.summary: The thickness of the track.

variables.summary: The corners of the track and the filled part.

variables.name: --sf-progress-bar-color
variables.summary: The visible percentage.

variables.name: --sf-progress-bar-gap
variables.summary: Space between the track and the percentage.

variables.summary: The filled segments; a status gives its own colour unless this is set.

variables.name: --sf-progress-scale-track-color
variables.summary: The segments not yet filled.

variables.name: --sf-progress-scale-segment-gap
variables.summary: Space between the ten segments.

variables.name: --sf-progress-scale-radius
variables.summary: The corners of the segment row.

variables.name: --sf-progress-scale-color
variables.summary: The visible percentage.

variables.name: --sf-progress-scale-gap
variables.summary: Space between the segments and the percentage.

variables.summary: The arc, the dots or the comet: the current ink unless set.

variables.name: --sf-spinner-track-color
variables.summary: The ring under the arc.

variables.summary: The drawing's box, the icon of a button of the same size by default.

variables.name: --sf-spinner-stroke-width
variables.summary: The ring's stroke, in units of the 24-unit icon grid.

variables.name: --sf-spinner-gap
variables.summary: Space between the drawing and its words.

variables.name: --sf-spinner-text-color
variables.summary: The words under the drawing.

variables.name: --sf-skeleton-background-color
variables.summary: The placeholder bars and shapes.

variables.name: --sf-skeleton-highlight-color
variables.summary: The light that runs over a bar in the wave animation.

variables.name: --sf-skeleton-radius
variables.summary: The corners of a bar; a circle stays round.

variables.name: --sf-skeleton-gap
variables.summary: Space between repeated bars (lines follow one another with none).

variables.name: --sf-skeleton-animation-duration
variables.summary: One pulse or one wave.

variables.summary: The widest the block form grows.

variables.summary: Room above and below the block form.

variables.summary: Space between the action buttons.

variables.summary: Room inside the row: none at rest, a step with surface.

variables.summary: Space between the slides, the controls and the thumbnails.

variables.summary: How an image fits its slide in the lightbox.

variables.name: --sf-gallery-slide-min-height
variables.summary: The lowest a lightbox slide may be.

variables.summary: A caption under an image in the lightbox.

variables.summary: The line at rest: none by default.

variables.summary: The line while hovered or dragged.

variables.summary: The trigger's words.

variables.summary: The open panel's fill.

variables.summary: The heading's ink.

variables.name: --sf-page-header-star-color
variables.summary: The star's ink while the page is a favourite.

variables.name: --sf-list-item-background-color
